title: French Normandy Apple Cream Sauce
description: A quick cider reduction and softened apple build a rounded cream sauce for pork.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the 10-inch HexClad skillet over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Build the flavor
steps.text: Finely dice any whole produce. Cook {apple}, {thyme} for 5–7 minutes, stirring until soft; add a spoonful of water if the pan catches.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.text: Whisk in {applejuice}, {broth}, {milk}, {mustard} gradually. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes until the flavors come together.

steps.title: Smooth the base
steps.text: Cool just off the boil. Tilt the pan and blend with a submerged immersion blender until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Pour the slurry into the simmering sauce while whisking. Bubble gently for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Fold in {creamcheese} off heat. Measure into a heatproof jug; add hot water to reach 1 cup, or simmer excess away before serving.

notes: Yield: 1 cup. Low-sodium option for the full batch: use 16 g broth and replace the remaining broth with sodium-free water and keep the same final yield. Use unsalted broth throughout. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, use half the pepper or chile if present and thin each portion with warm water. Make ahead: chill in small jars for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in quarter-cup portions up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: whisk over low heat to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat as above. Dairy swap: use avocado oil for butter, unsweetened oat milk for milk, and plain dairy-free cream cheese where needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 52 kcal, 1.0 g protein, 6.9 g total carbohydrate, 2.3 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 19 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 51 kcal, 0.9 g protein, 6.9 g total carbohydrate, 2.3 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 17 mg sodium.
